note: Bank of Palestine: its Visa and Mastercard Classic card, in US dollars, charges 2% a month on the unpaid balance; it costs $25 to renew when it expires, every two years, its validity, written as 12.50 a year; the issue fee isn't written.

sources.title: Bank of Palestine, Visa and Mastercard credit cards
sources.said: Commission for issuing the card ... $25 for primary card ... Fee for card renewal (if expired) ... Interest on unpaid amount in the card on monthly basis ... 2% for the used unpaid balance in the card ... Validity of the Card ... 2 years ... Primary currency of the card ... US Dollar
